mintAuthority.summary: DUSD token (0x63d74d22e689c715a04f2c13962b1f77f443d35b) is a direct, non-proxy deployment owned by AltoTimelockController (0xfae841679dc1a93d225ecc827e4bbf3e8d703f86, 1-hour min delay, self-administered). The timelock's proposer/executor is a 3-of-5 Alto Safe (0xc49bf619cc9a68f84a6c9ab88506f2627565a4d0). At Ethereum block 25540452, 11 current contract minters were active in allowedMinter; each is restricted by its on-chain minterConfig ceiling. The token owner can change minter status and ceilings through the timelock, while a minter cannot change its own token-level ceiling.

controls.label: AltoTimelockController (DUSD owner)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25540452, DUSD.owner() = 0xfae841679dc1a93d225ecc827e4bbf3e8d703f86. Verified DUSD source restricts setMinterStatus and setMinterCeiling to onlyOwner, so this timelock can add/revoke a minter and raise or lower any token-level ceiling. Its getMinDelay() is 3600 seconds; existing RoleGranted/RoleRevoked evidence resolves the proposer/executor Safe and revocation of deployer roles.

controls.label: Alto governance Safe (proposer/executor on timelock)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25540452, getOwners() returned the five listed owners, getThreshold() returned 3, and getModulesPaginated() returned no enabled modules. hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE, Safe) and hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE, Safe) both returned true on the DUSD owner timelock. It can therefore schedule and execute the owner's setMinterStatus and setMinterCeiling calls after the current 1-hour timelock delay.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25540452, DUSD.owner() = AltoTimelockController (0xfae841679dc1a93d225ecc827e4bbf3e8d703f86). Verified DUSD source shows mint() is limited to allowedMinter[msg.sender] and minterConfig[msg.sender].ceiling, while onlyOwner can change minter status and ceilings. The direct, non-proxy constructor only initializes the pauser and does not seed a minter or ceiling. Full SetMinterStatus and SetMinterCeiling history from block 0 returned 15 and 29 events respectively; state reads over the 13 unique status-event addresses found 11 active minters and 2 inactive addresses. The controls enumerate the complete active set at this block. The owner timelock remains governed by the 3-of-5 Alto Safe after its 1-hour delay. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: every cap or minter-set change must pass the enforced one-hour timelock, while current issuance is fully on-chain collateral-gated with no off-chain attestor or prudential supervisor.
